description: Five of six saved strategies begin in 2023 and have never been measured through a bear market. Their stock-level price panel starts 2022-12-02, so they cannot be extended backwards. Their ENGINE can: multi-horizon cross-sectional momentum with sector balance, volatility targeting and costs, run on 9 SPDR sector ETFs with history to 1998. This probes the mechanism, not the strategies.
honest_scope: A pass here does not validate any saved strategy. A failure here is strong evidence that the family is regime-dependent, because the same engine is being tested on the same kind of signal over a much longer sample.
no_parameter_search: The engine parameters are copied from the saved sector ensemble's frozen configuration. Nothing is tuned inside this probe; a single configuration is run once.
